blog.title: LiftLedger: never miss an elevator test date
blog.description: Track every unit under contract — Category 1 annual tests and Category 5 five-year tests — with overdue flags, due-soon alerts, and a printable compliance summary.

body.text: A lapsed elevator test is a violation waiting to happen. Under ASME A17.1, every unit needs a Category 1 test every year and a Category 5 full-load test every five years — and small independent shops still track those cycles on whiteboards, phone calls, and spreadsheets.

Register each unit: building, unit label, type, install date, and your last test dates. LiftLedger works out when the next Category 1 and Category 5 tests land, then shows what's overdue, what's due in the next 30 days, and which five-year tests are coming up in the next 90. Log a test when it's done and the cycles roll forward on their own.
